A1.justification: Both complete 32-page PDFs describe TrustCLIP and provide readable text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–H. Content can be matched across the main-text reflow; pages 16–32, including the references and appendices, render identically.

before.justification: v1 reports original TrustCLIP and TrustLLaVA experiments, including classification, multimodal evaluation, reconstruction attacks, ablations, and the CelebA analysis in Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Tables 1–4 and A.1–A.7, together with qualitative reconstruction examples.

M1.justification: The frozen encoder, residual privacy projection, joint task/reconstruction objective, fixed training attacker, and adaptive evaluation attacker are unchanged. Section 3 and Appendix B retain the same method components and procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions retain SUN397 classification, the same VLM benchmark suite, COCO qualitative examples, and the CelebA identity/attribute study. Training data and evaluated attacker scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain unprotected CLIP, all Gaussian-noise levels, Qwen-VL, Qwen-VL-Chat, LLaVA-1.5, and LLaVA-SP. Appendix E also retains the same IP-Adapter, IP-Adapter Plus, and CNN-decoder comparisons.

E3.justification: Reported splits, preprocessing, sample sizes, model configurations, training schedules, metrics, and attacker evaluation procedures are unchanged in Section 4 and Appendices C and H. No new experimental protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: The loss, initialization, and training-schedule ablations are retained, as are matched-noise controls, adaptive/unseen-attacker tests, identity-versus-attribute analysis, feature entropy, and computational-overhead analysis. Table 4 is relocated without changing its category analysis.

E5.justification: Fixed-seed statements and reconstruction reporting as mean ± standard deviation are unchanged. Neither version adds different run-count information, uncertainty-estimation procedures, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 and A.1–A.7 retain their entries and values, and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains 82.915 Top-1 for L2+LPIPS at reconstruction weight 0.25, and Table 3 retains TrustLLaVA DSIM of 0.39 ± 0.09.

T1.justification: The projection definitions, reconstruction loss, optimization equations, and data-processing-inequality reasoning are unchanged in Section 3 and the appendices. No mathematical assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about generative leakage, adversarial privacy projection, downstream utility, and applicability to classification and VLM pipelines.

C2.justification: Explanations of selective information suppression and identity initialization are unchanged. Both retain the same qualifications concerning fine-grained tasks, CLIP-focused evaluation, training against one attacker family, and residual spatial information in reconstructions.

D1.justification: Architecture specifications, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, and inference details remain unchanged. The project/gallery access information and planned code-release statement are also retained.

R1.justification: The cited works and bibliography are unchanged, as are the related-work discussion, novelty claims, and distinctions from DP-CLIP, NinjaDesc, SPAct, and other privacy approaches.

P1.justification: v2 removes the Meta affiliation and the 'Work done during Meta internship' footnote, and renumbers the remaining affiliations and a footnote. Author names, scientific prose, terminology, and section order are unchanged.

P2.justification: The shorter title-page affiliation block changes pagination and spacing throughout the main text. Table 4 moves from page 13 to page 12, and Figure 4 shifts upward on page 13. Figure content, table structures, captions, and appendix layout remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The revision changes affiliation information and modestly reflows the main text, including relocating Table 4. Scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations are retained. These presentation changes do not establish a meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
